summary.source: Google Business Profile reviews synced into jvto-web reviews table

evidenceUses: AI-answer grounding for social proof questions
caveats: Review text is public Google review content but should be quoted selectively in public pages.
Crew and package links are inferred from existing JVTO review relations and package IDs where present.
Profile photo URLs and API credentials are intentionally excluded.
Review media URLs are stored as references only; binaries are not downloaded or rehosted.
Crew review counts use alias-adjusted matching; unresolved names are kept separate until owner mapping is confirmed.
Featured crew reviews include Google review traceability links and media references; media is not rehosted.
